model.name: Tripo 3.1
model.shortDescription: Tripo 3.1 by Tripo AI converts a single image into a textured, game-ready 3D asset with PBR materials, adjustable geometry density, and quad mesh output.

inputs.description: Enable texturing. Set to false for a model without textures.
inputs.label: Texture
inputs.name: texture

inputs.description: Texture quality level. 'Detailed' gives HD quality textures.
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.name: textureQuality

inputs.description: Determines the prioritization of texture alignment in the 3D model.
inputs.label: Alignment
inputs.name: textureAlignment

inputs.description: Geometry quality level. 'Detailed' gives HD quality geometry.
inputs.label: Geometry Quality
inputs.name: geometryQuality

inputs.description: Random seed for texture generation. Using the same seed will produce identical textures.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: textureSeed

inputs.description: Set orientation to 'Align Image' will automatically rotate the model to align the original image.
inputs.label: Orientation
inputs.name: orientation

inputs.description: Enable PBR generation. Default value is True. If this option is set to True, texture parameters will be ignored.
inputs.label: PBR
inputs.name: pbr

inputs.description: Maximum face count. Adaptive if unset. With Smart Low Poly: 1,000–20,000 (500–10,000 if Quad is also enabled). Otherwise capped at 1,500,000 (standard geometry) or 2,000,000 (detailed geometry). Quad alone caps face limit at 150,000.
inputs.label: Face Limit
inputs.name: faceLimit

inputs.description: Automatically scale the model to real-world dimensions, with the unit in meters.
inputs.label: Auto Size
inputs.name: autoSize

inputs.description: Enable quad mesh output (FBX format). When Smart Low Poly is off, face limit is capped at 150,000. When Smart Low Poly is on and Face Limit is unset, defaults to 10,000.
inputs.label: Quad
inputs.name: quad

inputs.description: Generate hand-crafted low-poly topology. When enabled and Face Limit is set: 1,000–20,000 (500–10,000 if Quad is also enabled).
inputs.label: Smart Low Poly
inputs.name: smartLowPoly

inputs.description: Generate segmented 3D model parts. Incompatible with texture, pbr, and quad.
inputs.label: Generate Parts
inputs.name: generateParts

inputs.description: Random seed for model generation. The seed controls the geometry generation process, ensuring identical models when the same seed is used.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: seed
